name: Mobile Suit Gundam: The One Year Tour

nodes.name: Tour 01
nodes.speaker: Docent RX
nodes.dialogue: Welcome to the Universal Century History Museum.{pause}We close in twenty minutes, and tonight's final visitors are already{pause}waiting at the first gallery.{pause}Docent Zaku arrives with a cart of casualty records taller than either of us.{pause}The lobby clock advances one minute out of professional concern.{pause}Our promise is simple: follow each decision, preserve each consequence,{pause}and leave no one reduced to a colored light.

nodes.name: Tour 02
nodes.speaker: Docent Zaku
nodes.dialogue: Before we begin: this hall once called itself a victory chronicle.{pause}We revised it.{pause}Every display now follows people, decisions, and consequences instead of{pause}polishing one faction's trophies.{pause}The archive doors seal at closing, and RX has assigned me a footnote{pause}cart with one bad wheel.{pause}I punch our first stop: Universal Century 0079.

nodes.name: Tour 03
nodes.speaker: Docent Zaku
nodes.dialogue: Side 3 declares itself the Principality of Zeon and fights the Earth{pause}Federation for independence.{pause}Mobile suits let Zeon overcome a huge numerical disadvantage.{pause}During the opening month, the war kills roughly half of humanity before{pause}settling into a terrible stalemate.{pause}The map has two faction colors and far too many empty lights.{pause}Neither color gets to claim the dead as a victory statistic.

nodes.name: Tour 04
nodes.speaker: Docent RX
nodes.dialogue: At Side 7, the Federation secretly tests Operation V: Gundam, Guncannon,{pause}Guntank, and the new ship White Base.{pause}Char Aznable sends three Zakus to investigate.{pause}A Zeon pilot attacks without orders, turning reconnaissance into a{pause}colony disaster.{pause}Fifteen-year-old Amuro Ray finds the Gundam manual after his neighbors are{pause}killed.{pause}He climbs into his father's machine because every trained answer{pause}around him is already gone.

nodes.name: Tour 05
nodes.speaker: Docent RX
nodes.dialogue: Amuro activates the RX-78-2 and defeats two Zakus through technical{pause}instinct, not heroic readiness.{pause}That success saves survivors and traps him in a role nobody asked{pause}whether he could bear.{pause}The museum's Gundam display lights brilliantly.{pause}Zaku turns down the victory lamp until the ruined colony can still be{pause}seen behind it.{pause}A weapon has risen, but the story has begun with refugees.

nodes.name: Tour Ticket 01
nodes.speaker: Docent RX
nodes.dialogue: I punch SIDE 7 into the tour ticket.{pause}The paper strip now has one bright stop and an alarming amount of blank{pause}space.{pause}Zaku unfolds the rest across the rail: Luna II, Earth, Jaburo, Side 6,{pause}Solomon, and A Baoa Qu.{pause}This is not a scoreboard.{pause}The ticket remembers decisions, not points, and it never awards a winner.{pause}Each punch means someone made a choice that narrowed the next set of{pause}choices.{pause}The ribbon also keeps causes from vanishing behind famous machines: a{pause}shortage can shape a duel, a funeral can redirect an army, and one frightened{pause}return can matter more than a captured base.{pause}If the chain ever feels crowded, the visitor guide can reopen the people or{pause}command plaque at the nearest gallery.

nodes.name: Tour 06
nodes.speaker: Docent Zaku
nodes.dialogue: White Base escapes carrying civilians, wounded soldiers, and{pause}three prototype mobile suits.{pause}Junior officer Bright Noa inherits command because the adults above him are{pause}dead or injured.{pause}Fraw Bow cares for three orphaned children while civilians become pilots,{pause}gunners, and mechanics.{pause}Char pursues them because Gundam could change the war.{pause}The ship's crew is whoever survived and kept moving.

nodes.name: Tour 07
nodes.speaker: Docent RX
nodes.dialogue: White Base attacks Char's supply ship because running without supplies{pause}is another kind of surrender.{pause}At Luna II, Federation officers arrest the refugees and confiscate{pause}their equipment for breaking protocol.{pause}Their own side treats survival as suspicious paperwork.{pause}Char's attack gives the crew a chance to escape.{pause}The official rescue system has now been outperformed by the emergency exit{pause}twice.

nodes.name: Tour 07B
nodes.speaker: Docent Zaku
nodes.dialogue: Amuro launches the Core Fighter to seek Federation contact, proving how{pause}isolated the ship remains.{pause}Refugees later demand to leave, and a temporary ceasefire reveals{pause}civilians trying to survive between armies.{pause}By the time Garma attacks again, Amuro is too exhausted to accept{pause}another launch order.{pause}The crew does not become dependable by feeling brave.{pause}They become dependable by naming fear, failing one another, and returning to{pause}their stations anyway.

nodes.name: Tour 08
nodes.speaker: Docent Zaku
nodes.dialogue: During atmospheric reentry, Char attacks where one mistake means{pause}burning up.{pause}Amuro must learn both combat and physics under fire.{pause}Char's pressure knocks White Base off course into Zeon-controlled North{pause}America.{pause}The route display marks this as an unfortunate detour.{pause}RX adds that the detour lasts most of the Earth campaign.{pause}I replace unfortunate with structurally decisive.

nodes.name: Tour 09
nodes.speaker: Docent RX
nodes.dialogue: This junction once split the collection into Personnel and Strategy{pause}halls.{pause}The White Base gallery keeps us beside the crew as strangers become a{pause}family.{pause}The war-map gallery follows the ambitions that steer armies.{pause}Both halls meet again at the final evacuation display because they{pause}preserve different evidence from the same war.{pause}History does not change with the doorway.{pause}What changes is what the room lets us notice.

nodes.name: Whitebase 01
nodes.speaker: Docent RX
nodes.dialogue: Garma Zabi hunts White Base across North America while Amuro sometimes{pause}refuses to launch from exhaustion.{pause}Refugees attempt to leave the ship, then discover that the battlefield{pause}follows them.{pause}The crew votes, argues, improvises, and keeps one another alive.{pause}Bright and Amuro are both teenagers forced into authority by adults who{pause}are absent or demanding.{pause}Their conflict is not discipline versus cowardice; it is two{pause}frightened people using the only controls they have.

nodes.name: Whitebase 02
nodes.speaker: Docent Zaku
nodes.dialogue: Char pretends to guide his friend Garma, then feeds him false tactical{pause}information.{pause}Garma charges into White Base's ambush and dies.{pause}His lover Icelina launches a doomed revenge attack.{pause}Gihren Zabi turns Garma's funeral into propaganda, while veteran Ramba Ral{pause}receives the next pursuit order.{pause}Private grief becomes another weapon before anyone has time to{pause}understand it.

nodes.name: Warmap 01
nodes.speaker: Docent Zaku
nodes.dialogue: Garma Zabi uses regional forces to hunt one prototype ship because{pause}victory could secure his place inside the ruling family.{pause}Char appears to help while quietly steering Garma toward failure.{pause}Meanwhile, White Base's repeated survival forces Zeon to spend commanders,{pause}supplies, and specialized machines on a moving target.{pause}One refugee ship becomes strategically important because both governments{pause}decide it is useful.

nodes.name: Warmap 02
nodes.speaker: Docent RX
nodes.dialogue: Char's false guidance leaves Garma exposed to White Base, and Garma{pause}dies.{pause}The betrayal advances Char's hidden revenge against the Zabi family{pause}that displaced his own.{pause}Icelina's retaliation adds another death to the chain.{pause}Gihren converts Garma's funeral into a rally, and Char is removed from{pause}command.{pause}The map loses a Zabi portrait, but the war machine gains a speech.

nodes.name: Ral Diorama 01
nodes.speaker: Docent Zaku
nodes.dialogue: The desert case begins with two commanders who do not receive what they{pause}need.{pause}Bright has a crew but almost no experience; Ramba Ral has experience{pause}but loses supplies to rival Zeon politics.{pause}Amuro sees only the veteran who can defeat him.{pause}The display shows the larger trap: frightened young command on one side,{pause}proud under-supported command on the other, and civilians between them.{pause}Hamon and Ral still choose loyalty to each other and their soldiers, which{pause}makes the exhibit warmer and more terrible.{pause}Competence cannot repair a command structure that withholds support, and{pause}youth cannot be hurried into trust by issuing another order.{pause}Ral's strength will expose Amuro's immaturity.{pause}Ral's own system will help kill him.

nodes.name: Earth 01
nodes.speaker: Docent RX
nodes.dialogue: Amuro meets his mother and discovers that survival has made him someone she{pause}can barely recognize.{pause}Ordinary Zeon soldiers later attach bombs to Gundam, and Amuro removes{pause}them by hand under a deadline.{pause}On Cucuruz Doan's island, a Zeon deserter protects children and refuses the{pause}war's machinery altogether.{pause}Three exhibits break the faction labels in different ways: family can{pause}fail to understand, enemies can be desperate, and a soldier can choose{pause}to stop.

nodes.name: Earth 02
nodes.speaker: Docent Zaku
nodes.dialogue: Sayla Mass takes Gundam without permission because she needs to learn whether{pause}Char is her lost brother.{pause}Amuro, exhausted and treated like replaceable equipment, quarrels with{pause}Bright and deserts with Gundam.{pause}He attacks a Zeon mine alone, believing one gifted pilot can solve a{pause}war.{pause}The mine is not decisive.{pause}The desert is very large.{pause}Even the museum map refuses to fit his plan on one card.

nodes.name: Earth 03
nodes.speaker: Docent Zaku
nodes.dialogue: Ramba Ral's experience exposes Amuro's immaturity, yet Ral is{pause}denied the support his mission needs.{pause}He boards White Base, recognizes Sayla as Artesia, and dies rather{pause}than surrender.{pause}Hamon attacks again in grief.{pause}Ryu Jose sacrifices himself to save Amuro and the ship.{pause}Courage does not protect the crew from loss.{pause}The memorial light stays dark for one full breath before our tour continues.

nodes.name: Earth 04
nodes.speaker: Docent RX
nodes.dialogue: Bright collapses under command strain while M'Quve closes a trap{pause}around White Base.{pause}Lieutenant Matilda keeps the ship supplied, then dies during the Black{pause}Tri-Stars' attack.{pause}At Odessa, Amuro exposes Federation traitor Elran and stops M'Quve's nuclear{pause}strike.{pause}The Federation wins its major Earth campaign and breaks Zeon's foothold.{pause}White Base has changed the war, but Amuro experiences victory as another name{pause}added to glass.

nodes.name: Odessa Memorial 01
nodes.speaker: Docent RX
nodes.dialogue: The Odessa map tries to illuminate every successful arrow at once.{pause}I cover the power switch with the ticket.{pause}Ryu's name sits beside the place where he bought the crew time; Matilda's sits{pause}beside the supplies that let them arrive at all.{pause}Around them, mechanics, medics, and pilots kept the ship moving through{pause}failures no campaign arrow can display.{pause}Stopping a nuclear strike matters.{pause}Breaking Zeon's Earth foothold matters.{pause}Neither result makes grief an accounting error.{pause}A useful record must hold the outcome, the labor, and the price in the same{pause}frame.{pause}We punch ODESSA only after the memorial names are readable.

nodes.name: Earth 05
nodes.speaker: Docent Zaku
nodes.dialogue: Char returns under Kycilia and attacks Belfast with amphibious mobile suits.{pause}Kai Shiden deserts, meets Miharu, and learns she spies for Zeon to support{pause}younger siblings.{pause}She boards White Base, then chooses to help Kai defend it when the attack{pause}becomes real.{pause}Miharu dies during the battle.{pause}Kai returns to the crew still skeptical of institutions, but no{pause}longer pretending that detachment keeps people safe.

nodes.name: Earth 05B
nodes.speaker: Docent RX
nodes.dialogue: The spy exhibit once displayed Miharu as a red token crossing a blue{pause}ship.{pause}Zaku replaces it with an empty chair and two small lunch tins for the{pause}siblings she supported.{pause}Kai's return matters because nobody orders it.{pause}He chooses the flawed crew he knows over the safety of pretending not to care.{pause}White Base is becoming a home precisely because its members can leave,{pause}understand the cost, and still come back.

nodes.name: Guide White Base 01
nodes.speaker: Docent RX
nodes.dialogue: The personnel plaque is arranged by what each person keeps moving.{pause}Bright gives frightened orders and slowly learns to listen.{pause}Mirai reads the ship and its people before the instruments finish{pause}arguing.{pause}Sayla carries a family history she refuses to let Char choose for her.{pause}Kai doubts every institution, yet returns when people need him.{pause}Amuro begins as the best machine operator in the room and must become{pause}someone who can live among the crew.{pause}The guide closes and returns us to Jaburo.

nodes.name: Earth 06
nodes.speaker: Docent RX
nodes.dialogue: White Base finally reaches Jaburo and accidentally leads Char to Federation{pause}headquarters.{pause}Woody dies opposing Char.{pause}Katz, Letz, and Kikka discover saboteurs and help save the new{pause}mass-produced GMs.{pause}Gundam's combat data is now reshaping the whole army.{pause}The refugees are formally absorbed into the military and sent back to space as{pause}a conspicuous decoy.{pause}Reaching safety has only made them more useful.

nodes.name: Earth 07
nodes.speaker: Docent Zaku
nodes.dialogue: Char and other Zeon forces try to stop White Base before it joins the main{pause}fleet.{pause}The crew's accumulated skill now produces victories that once seemed{pause}impossible.{pause}At neutral Side 6, Amuro meets his father Tem Ray, mentally damaged since{pause}Side 7 and fixated on an obsolete machine part.{pause}Amuro has outgrown both his father and the hope that better machinery{pause}alone can end war.{pause}Neutral ground offers recognition, not escape.

nodes.name: Earth 07B
nodes.speaker: Docent RX
nodes.dialogue: Side 6 also shows lives that continued outside White Base: Mirai faces{pause}Cameron, and the crew briefly sees what ordinary safety might have looked{pause}like.{pause}Then Conscon attacks outside the neutral colony and Amuro destroys his{pause}force with alarming speed.{pause}The museum counter cannot decide whether to flash SKILL or DANGER, so it{pause}flashes both.{pause}Amuro's ability is growing faster than the adults around him can understand{pause}its human cost.

nodes.name: Side6 Archive 01
nodes.speaker: Docent Zaku
nodes.dialogue: Side 6 gives Amuro three reflections instead of safety.{pause}His father sees only a machine part; Cameron offers Mirai the life she{pause}might have chosen; Lalah recognizes Amuro before either can explain how.{pause}One reflection is damaged memory, one is an unlived future, and one is a new{pause}kind of connection.{pause}The war immediately asks which of them can be made useful.{pause}We punch SIDE 6, and the ticket mechanism hesitates over whether recognition{pause}counts as progress or warning.

nodes.name: Space 01
nodes.speaker: Docent RX
nodes.dialogue: At Side 6, Amuro meets Lalah Sune before he understands her bond with{pause}Char.{pause}They recognize something in one another immediately.{pause}Amuro's growing awareness also lets him destroy conventional attackers{pause}with frightening speed.{pause}Newtypes may represent wider perception, empathy, and connection.{pause}Both militaries mostly see faster targeting.{pause}The next gallery asks whether we follow the people who might{pause}understand one another, or the powers trying to own that possibility.

nodes.name: Solomon Memorial 01
nodes.speaker: Docent Zaku
nodes.dialogue: Before the final archive divides, Solomon fills the glass.{pause}The Federation uses Solar System to burn through the fortress defenses; Dozle{pause}answers with Big Zam.{pause}Sleggar strikes the mobile armor knowing he may not return, and Amuro finishes{pause}the opening he creates.{pause}Dozle dies fighting for a regime that has already spent his family as{pause}symbols.{pause}The fortress model is enormous, but the missing chair beneath it controls{pause}the room.{pause}That contrast is the point: strategy changes history at one scale while{pause}absence changes every ordinary ritual at another.{pause}The map calls the fortress captured.{pause}The roster calls one station empty.{pause}Both records are true, so the exhibit keeps both lights on.

nodes.name: Guide Zabi 01
nodes.speaker: Docent Zaku
nodes.dialogue: The command plaque has too many arrows and one family at the center.{pause}Degwin founded the Principality but can no longer control what his{pause}children made of it.{pause}Gihren turns ideology and family deaths into fuel.{pause}Kycilia builds rival command networks and recruits Char without{pause}understanding his revenge.{pause}Dozle fights for family and soldiers while serving the same state.{pause}Char is Casval Deikun inside their machine, waiting for openings.{pause}The plaque folds shut before its arrows can stab another label.

nodes.name: People 01
nodes.speaker: Docent RX
nodes.dialogue: The Federation assaults Solomon.{pause}Sleggar Law sacrifices himself to open a path against Dozle Zabi's Big{pause}Zam, and Amuro finishes the fight.{pause}Dozle dies defending the fortress, another Zabi branch cut away by the war{pause}it commands.{pause}The victory lamp ignites, notices the empty crew station, and dims itself.{pause}White Base continues because grief and duty have become inseparable.

nodes.name: People 02
nodes.speaker: Docent Zaku
nodes.dialogue: At Texas Colony, Amuro defeats M'Quve while Char and Sayla confront their{pause}hidden family history.{pause}Char is Casval Rem Deikun; Sayla is Artesia.{pause}They are children of Zeon Zum Deikun, and Char entered the Zabi state to{pause}avenge their family.{pause}Sayla refuses to make revenge her home.{pause}Char's divided loyalties now pull against Amuro, Lalah, Zeon, and the{pause}mission that created his mask.

nodes.name: People 03
nodes.speaker: Docent RX
nodes.dialogue: Zeon deploys Challia Bull and then Lalah as Newtype weapons.{pause}Amuro and Lalah communicate across the battlefield with a depth{pause}neither side's command understands.{pause}She remains loyal to Char and shields him from Amuro's attack.{pause}Amuro kills her.{pause}Mutual recognition arrives inside machinery built to prevent it.{pause}Char and Amuro turn their shared grief into blame, and the gallery lights{pause}become two circles that almost overlap.

nodes.name: People 03B
nodes.speaker: Docent Zaku
nodes.dialogue: The two circles remain on the wall after the machines vanish.{pause}One holds Amuro's grief, one Char's, and Lalah's light crosses both.{pause}Neither pilot can accept that understanding arrived too late to prevent the{pause}shot.{pause}So each turns pain into a simpler story about the other.{pause}The exhibit refuses that simplification.{pause}It leaves the circles unfinished, because a connection can be real{pause}even when the people inside it fail.

nodes.name: People 04
nodes.speaker: Docent Zaku
nodes.dialogue: Degwin Zabi secretly approaches Federation commander Revil to seek{pause}peace.{pause}Gihren fires the Solar Ray colony laser, killing both men and wrecking much of{pause}the Federation fleet.{pause}Kycilia confirms that Gihren knowingly killed their father, then kills{pause}Gihren and takes command.{pause}The Zabi family board finally pulls itself off the wall.{pause}A dictatorship that weaponized everyone has reached its last available{pause}target: itself.

nodes.name: People 05
nodes.speaker: Docent RX
nodes.dialogue: The surviving Federation force attacks A Baoa Qu.{pause}Char sorties in the unfinished Zeong and duels Amuro until Zeong and{pause}Gundam destroy one another.{pause}They continue the fight on foot, as if losing the machines might finally{pause}reveal what the feud is for.{pause}Sayla interrupts them.{pause}Char remembers the Zabis were his original target and kills Kycilia as she{pause}tries to escape.{pause}The regime collapses around personal revenge.

nodes.name: People 06
nodes.speaker: Docent Zaku
nodes.dialogue: White Base is destroyed inside the fortress, but its people are still{pause}alive.{pause}Amuro reaches outward and guides them through smoke, wreckage, and closing{pause}paths.{pause}Their voices guide him back in return.{pause}He escapes in the Core Fighter and rejoins the crew.{pause}The Gundam is left behind.{pause}The boy who began alone inside a weapon ends by finding the people he{pause}wants to return to.

nodes.name: People 07
nodes.speaker: Docent RX
nodes.dialogue: The war ends soon afterward, but our tour does not award a clean{pause}heroic badge.{pause}I remove HERO from my docent hook.{pause}Zaku removes VILLAIN from his.{pause}We replace both with WITNESS.{pause}The broken exit path finally points toward the open door, and our ticket{pause}receives its last punch: HOME.{pause}The museum clock reaches zero, then waits for everyone to leave{pause}together.

nodes.name: People Coda
nodes.speaker: Museum Lights
nodes.dialogue: The ticket glows HOME. Two small docents hold the door while every reflected{pause}name crosses into morning.

nodes.name: Power 01
nodes.speaker: Docent Zaku
nodes.dialogue: The Federation's Solar System and mobile-suit fleet break Solomon while{pause}Dozle answers with Big Zam.{pause}Sleggar sacrifices himself to create an opening, Amuro destroys the mobile{pause}armor, and Dozle dies.{pause}The strategic map calls this a fortress victory.{pause}The crew roster calls it another empty station.{pause}Technology can decide where a battle turns without deciding what the{pause}turn costs.

nodes.name: Power 02
nodes.speaker: Docent RX
nodes.dialogue: M'Quve falls at Texas Colony while Char and Sayla reveal their Deikun{pause}identities.{pause}Char's revenge has been embedded inside Zeon's command structure from the{pause}beginning.{pause}Now that structure is fragmenting: commanders compete, family loyalties{pause}split, and Char's attention drifts toward Amuro and Lalah.{pause}The war map gains more arrows while its chain of command loses people able{pause}to agree where they point.

nodes.name: Power 03
nodes.speaker: Docent Zaku
nodes.dialogue: Zeon attempts organized Newtype warfare with Challia Bull and Lalah's{pause}Elmeth.{pause}Amuro's own Newtype awareness exceeds Gundam's reaction speed, forcing{pause}the machine to be upgraded around him.{pause}Yet the military advantage hides the human fact: Amuro and Lalah can{pause}understand each other across enemy lines.{pause}She dies shielding Char, and that possibility of connection is converted{pause}into more rivalry.{pause}Every sensor reads the event; no command system understands it.

nodes.name: Power 03B
nodes.speaker: Docent RX
nodes.dialogue: The systems display compares reaction times, weapon ranges, and command{pause}delays.{pause}Every number improves until the screen reaches the moment Lalah{pause}understands Amuro.{pause}There is no field for it.{pause}The militaries can measure the faster pilot and redesign the machine{pause}around him.{pause}They cannot represent why two enemies briefly perceive one another as{pause}complete people.{pause}What the table cannot store becomes the most important fact in the{pause}room.

nodes.name: Power 04
nodes.speaker: Docent RX
nodes.dialogue: Degwin attempts peace with Revil.{pause}Gihren fires Solar Ray through ally and enemy alike, killing them both{pause}and damaging the Federation fleet.{pause}Kycilia kills Gihren for murdering their father and assumes command just as{pause}the final attack begins.{pause}Zeon's most powerful weapon cannot solve the contradiction at its{pause}center.{pause}It only removes the people who might have ended the war another way.

nodes.name: Power 05
nodes.speaker: Docent Zaku
nodes.dialogue: At A Baoa Qu, the damaged Federation force advances because Zeon's command is{pause}collapsing faster than its fortress.{pause}Char's incomplete Zeong and Amuro's Gundam destroy one another.{pause}The two pilots continue on foot until Sayla breaks the duel.{pause}Char kills Kycilia, completing his revenge as the state around her{pause}disintegrates.{pause}The final machines are spectacular wreckage; the strategic result comes{pause}from institutions consuming themselves.

nodes.name: Power 06
nodes.speaker: Docent RX
nodes.dialogue: White Base is lost inside the fortress, but Amuro's Newtype awareness guides{pause}the crew to escape routes no tactical display can see.{pause}Their voices guide him home in return.{pause}He abandons Gundam, leaves in the Core Fighter, and rejoins them.{pause}The decisive system at the end is not a superweapon or a command hierarchy.{pause}It is a group of people recognizing one another across the wreckage.

nodes.name: Power 07
nodes.speaker: Docent Zaku
nodes.dialogue: The war ends soon afterward.{pause}Our wall still contains Federation blue, Zeon red, and more punched stops{pause}than either docent hook was designed to carry.{pause}RX removes HERO from his hook.{pause}I remove VILLAIN.{pause}We hang WITNESS between them and point visitors toward the repaired exit{pause}path.{pause}The final arrow is not a faction color.{pause}It is the warm light of people finding a way home together.

nodes.name: Power Coda
nodes.speaker: Museum Lights
nodes.dialogue: The command arrows go dark. WITNESS remains lit above the path that no{pause}weapon could choose.

tracks.name: What the Machines Could Not Decide
